title: NSM — Alerts
description: Signature alerts and behavior findings with triage state, verdicts and the automated response.

panels.title: Suricata alerts

targets.rawSql: SELECT count() AS alerts FROM nsm.suricata_alert WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND in_iface = 'ens4'

panels.description: Signature alerts on ens4 in the range

panels.title: Severity 1

targets.rawSql: SELECT countIf(alert_severity = 1) AS severe FROM nsm.suricata_alert WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND in_iface = 'ens4'

panels.description: Highest-severity alerts; RSP-002 blocks their sources

panels.title: Unreviewed severity-1

targets.rawSql: SELECT count() AS unreviewed FROM (SELECT DISTINCT concat(toString(alert_signature_id), '|', src_ip) AS pair FROM nsm.suricata_alert WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND in_iface = 'ens4' AND alert_severity = 1) AS a LEFT ANTI JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT subject FROM nsm.verdicts WHERE source = 'suricata') AS rv ON rv.subject = a.pair

panels.description: Signature/source pairs with no analyst verdict yet — the triage queue below

panels.title: Behavior findings now

targets.rawSql: SELECT count() AS findings FROM nsm.detection_hits WHERE run_at = (SELECT max(run_at) FROM nsm.detection_runs WHERE NOT backfill)

panels.description: Rows from the latest hourly run of DET-101..109 (24 h window)

panels.title: Automatic blocks

targets.rawSql: SELECT count() AS blocks FROM nsm.response_actions WHERE mode = 'enforce' AND action = 'block' AND trigger != 'manual' AND $__timeFilter(created_at)

panels.description: Sources blocked by the responder in the range (enforce mode)

panels.title: Suppressed by tuning

targets.rawSql: SELECT argMax(stats_detect_alerts_suppressed, timestamp) - argMin(stats_detect_alerts_suppressed, timestamp) AS suppressed FROM nsm.suricata_stats WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)

panels.description: Alerts Suricata suppressed through threshold.config (TUNE-001) in the range; resets when the engine restarts

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(timestamp) AS time, concat('severity ', toString(alert_severity)) AS level, count() AS alerts FROM nsm.suricata_alert WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND in_iface = 'ens4' GROUP BY time, level ORDER BY time

panels.title: New behavior findings

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(first_reported) AS time, det AS detection, count() AS findings FROM (SELECT hit_key, any(detection_id) AS det, min(run_at) AS first_reported FROM nsm.detection_hits GROUP BY hit_key) WHERE $__timeFilter(first_reported) GROUP BY time, detection ORDER BY time

panels.description: Findings (hit_key) by the run that first reported them; backfilled runs included

panels.title: Triage queue: severity-1 without verdict

targets.rawSql: SELECT a.pair AS signature_source, a.sig AS signature, a.n AS alerts, a.first_at AS first_seen, a.last_at AS last_seen, a.url AS sample_url FROM (SELECT concat(toString(alert_signature_id), '|', src_ip) AS pair, any(alert_signature) AS sig, count() AS n, min(timestamp) AS first_at, max(timestamp) AS last_at, anyIf(http_url, http_url != '') AS url FROM nsm.suricata_alert WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND in_iface = 'ens4' AND alert_severity = 1 GROUP BY pair) AS a LEFT ANTI JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT subject FROM nsm.verdicts WHERE source = 'suricata') AS rv ON rv.subject = a.pair ORDER BY last_seen DESC LIMIT 50

panels.description: Record a verdict: sudo detections/verdict.sh suricata '<sid>|<ip>' true_positive|false_positive <TUNE-id|-> "note"

panels.title: Top signatures

targets.rawSql: SELECT alert_signature_id AS sid, any(alert_signature) AS signature, any(alert_severity) AS level, count() AS alerts, uniqExact(src_ip) AS sources FROM nsm.suricata_alert WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND in_iface = 'ens4' GROUP BY sid ORDER BY alerts DESC LIMIT 20

panels.description: Most frequent signatures in the range

panels.title: Alert sources with verdicts and response

targets.rawSql: SELECT a.src AS source, a.n AS alerts, a.severe AS severity_1, a.sigs AS signatures, pv.verdicts AS verdicts, ra.response AS response FROM (SELECT src_ip AS src, count() AS n, countIf(alert_severity = 1) AS severe, uniqExact(alert_signature_id) AS sigs FROM nsm.suricata_alert WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND in_iface = 'ens4' GROUP BY src) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT splitByChar('|', subject)[2] AS ip, arrayStringConcat(groupUniqArray(latest_verdict), ', ') AS verdicts FROM (SELECT subject, argMax(verdict, created_at) AS latest_verdict FROM nsm.verdicts WHERE source = 'suricata' GROUP BY subject) GROUP BY ip) AS pv ON pv.ip = a.src LEFT JOIN (SELECT ip, concat(argMax(action, created_at), ' (', argMax(mode, created_at), ')') AS response FROM nsm.response_actions GROUP BY ip) AS ra ON ra.ip = a.src ORDER BY severity_1 DESC, alerts DESC LIMIT 25

panels.description: verdicts: analyst judgements for this source's signatures; response: the responder's latest decision for the IP

panels.title: Current behavior findings

targets.rawSql: SELECT h.detection_id AS detection, h.severity AS level, h.src AS source, h.dst AS destination, h.dst_port AS port, h.score AS finding_score, h.summary AS what, if(dv.latest_verdict = '', 'unreviewed', dv.latest_verdict) AS verdict FROM nsm.detection_hits AS h LEFT JOIN (SELECT subject, argMax(verdict, created_at) AS latest_verdict FROM nsm.verdicts WHERE source = 'detection' GROUP BY subject) AS dv ON dv.subject = h.hit_key WHERE h.run_at = (SELECT max(run_at) FROM nsm.detection_runs WHERE NOT backfill) ORDER BY finding_score DESC

panels.description: Latest hourly run; reviewed findings carry their verdict (docs/tuning-log.md)

panels.title: Recent alerts

targets.rawSql: SELECT timestamp AS time, alert_severity AS level, alert_signature_id AS sid, alert_signature AS signature, src_ip, dest_port, app_proto, http_url AS url, community_id FROM nsm.suricata_alert WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND in_iface = 'ens4' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 100

panels.description: community_id finds the same flow in nsm.zeek_conn
